item.title: Lipstick on a Snake
item.description: Teams need a scripting language, so they reach for Python, and they are right to. Later the same code needs to be production software, and instead of reconsidering the language they try to shoehorn Python into the role. Applying lipstick on a snake still makes it a snake.
